t: Marimekko x Target - Real Life Style
s: April 21, 2016 - The aesthetic of Marimekko was just right for the 60’s and gained popularity when worn by the likes of Jackie Kennedy. Manufacturing both textiles and ready-made product, up till now you have been able to find Marimekko in their own stores as well as the likes of Crate & Barrel and H&M. What’s news? Target has gotten ahold of the colorful, graphic designs and gone mad. The bathing suits are out of this world cute, and affordable! I’m thinking of buying “my kids” one of the tents.
